features.f: A tall, willowy elf woman: slim waist, long neck, very long slender arms and legs. Long pointed ears that jut straight out sideways from the head, almost as long as the face is tall, tapering to sharp tips that angle slightly up and back; a narrow oval face with high cheekbones, a small pointed chin, a slim straight nose and almond eyes. No tail, horns, fur or scales.
features.m: A very tall, lanky elf man: long legs, narrow hips, slim but squared shoulders and long arms. The same long pointed ears jutting straight out sideways, almost as long as the face is tall; a long narrow face with a strong angular jaw, high cheekbones, a heavy straight brow, a long straight nose and thin lips. No tail, horns, fur or scales.

f.desc: A black sleeveless leather bodice with a high halter collar, laced down the front with white criss-cross cords, an olive-green band across the chest and an olive belt with a silver clasp at the waist, over short black leather shorts; one detached puffy white sleeve on the left upper arm, and white open overskirt panels hanging from the hips with long pointed, jagged tips. Black fingerless half-gloves, and black thigh-high leather boots laced with white cross-ties at the top, with a periwinkle-blue strap round one thigh and small wedge heels.

m.desc: A black thigh-length asymmetric surcoat with elbow-length sleeves, laced down the front with white zigzag cords, a mustard-yellow sash draped over one shoulder and small silver clasps, worn over a white shirt whose sleeves show below the elbows, with a white collar and a thin black choker. A wide white belt with a big silver buckle over dark charcoal trousers with brown leather knee straps, black fingerless leather gloves, and cream-white thigh-high jackboots folded over at the top, with a brown leather strap and small pouch round one thigh.

notes: Hairstyles: from CharaMakeType rows 4-7 (Wildwood m/f = 4/5, Duskwight m/f = 6/7), menu 'Hairstyle' (Lobby 234); its SubMenuParam values are CharaMakeCustomize row ids (m 521-600, f 651-736), listed here in menu order. Both clans have the identical list. Every entry has IsPurchasable=false and no HintItem/UnlockLink, so all 48 m / 52 f are free at creation; the purchasable and Modern Aesthetics rows (e.g. 533, 538, 543...) are left out of the menu. f01-f16 (FeatureID 1-12 and 51-54) and m01-m12 (FeatureID 1-12) are the original A Realm Reborn styles; f17-f52 and m13-m48 (FeatureID 102-178) are older aesthetician styles the creator now offers free. Lalafell's creator menu (row 9) also holds 52, so take only f01-f16 / m01-m12 to match a Lalafell set built from the originals. Note the female menu puts FeatureID 3 at f11 and FeatureID 7 at f15. f11-f14 are one cut whose hairpins differ only in colour (silver, gold, dark bronze, rose gold). Accessory colours are as the creator icons show them; in game some may tint with the highlight colour. Icons saved in races/elezen-icons (m01.png.. f52.png). Attire: CharaMakeType Equipment[0] is model 86 v2 (m) / 87 v2 (f) for all four rows, matching the Elezen Surcoat set (131158) and Elezen Gown set (131159); Wildwood and Duskwight wear the same outfit. Colours from the official Elezen render on consolegameswiki (the Gamer Escape gown model is lit blue). The female's puffy sleeve is on one arm only (her left). Clan differences: Wildwood have an 'Ear Clasps' option (jewellery on the ears), Duskwight a 'Tattoos' option instead; neither is on by default. Height: vhpg.com chart, creator slider 0%/100% (averages m 201.9 cm, f 192.5 cm; scale = average / 90 cm). An older community estimate (ffxiv-roleplayers) gives m 6'3"-7'0", f 5'7"-6'6", so the female minimum is uncertain. Skins: creator (interface) half of chara/xls/charamake/human.cmp as exported by xivdyetools, 192 per clan and gender in an 8-column grid; not checked against an in-game screenshot. Picks (clan, index): porcelain Duskwight 0, fair peach Wildwood 0, warm beige Wildwood 82 (Wildwood default), ash grey Duskwight 50 (Duskwight female default; male default is 43, #8A9192), golden tan Wildwood 67, slate blue-grey Duskwight 83, warm brown Wildwood 133, deep brown Wildwood 167. Duskwight's palette runs to cool grey and blue-grey skin; Wildwood's from warm peach to dark brown.
